name: git-commit-assist
description: Review staged git changes and get code improvement suggestions powered by Context7 documentation

gitCommitAssist.model.markdownDescription: Gemini model identifier used for AI review generation. Must be a model name supported by your API provider.

gitCommitAssist.maxOutputTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum number of tokens in the AI response. Set to `0` to use the model's default limit.

gitCommitAssist.context7Enabled.description: Fetch live library documentation from Context7 to enrich AI review context. Disable to skip the network lookup.

gitCommitAssist.responseLanguage.description: Language for the AI-generated code review response.

gitCommitAssist.docsDirectory.markdownDescription: Glob pattern for Markdown documentation files relative to the workspace root. Used when **Include Markdown context** is enabled in the sidebar.

scripts.compile: tsc -p ./ && tsc -p tsconfig.webview.json && npm run copy-webview-assets
scripts.copy-webview-assets: mkdir -p out/webview/screens && cp src/webview/sidebar.html src/webview/sidebar.css out/webview/ && cp src/webview/screens/*.html out/webview/screens/
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
